title: Random Initialization as a Baseline for Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30950v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) use self-supervised pretraining to learn reusable representations for downstream tasks such as multivariate time series classification (MTSC). We examine how much pretrained weights contribute beyond the architecture itself by comparing seven publicly released instances from four TSFM families with architecture-matched randomly initialized counterparts on the UEA MTSC archive. For each instance, five random initializations are evaluated using four classifiers on frozen representations: ridge classification, logistic regression, RBF SVM, and random forest. After model-specific exclusions due to computational constraints, the study comprises 183 paired dataset-level comparisons. Pretraining improves mean accuracy for all seven instances, but the gains are modest, ranging from 1.43 to 5.19 percentage points, with an overall average improvement of 2.58 points. translated_title: 随机初始化作为时间序列基础模型的基线
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）利用自监督预训练来学习可复用的表示，以用于多元时间序列分类（MTSC）等下游任务。我们通过在UEA MTSC数据集上，将来自四个TSFM家族的七个公开发布模型实例与架构匹配的随机初始化对应模型进行比较，来检验预训练权重在架构本身之外究竟贡献了多少。对于每个实例，在冻结表示上使用四种分类器评估五个随机初始化版本：岭分类、逻辑回归、RBF支持向量机和随机森林。在因计算限制进行模型特定的排除之后，该研究共包含183组配对的数据集级比较。预训练提高了所有七个实例的平均准确率，但增益较为有限，介于1.43至5.19个百分点之间，总体平均提升为2.58个百分点。七个实例中有三个的逐实例Wilcoxon符号秩检验……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过系统对比发现，时间序列基础模型的预训练权重相比架构相同的随机初始化模型仅带来平均2.58个百分点的准确率提升，表明预训练收益有限，随机初始化可作为评估此类模型的有效基线。
en_tdlr: By comparing seven time series foundation models with architecture-matched randomly initialized counterparts on the UEA MTSC archive, this study shows that pretraining yields only modest gains (average 2.58 percentage points), suggesting random initialization serves as a strong baseline.
